title: Applied AI Workflow & Prompt Curriculum
summary: A practical hands-on training program helping non-technical and technical staff apply modern AI tools, structured prompting, and review workflows.
challenge: Teams adopt AI tools ad hoc without consistent prompt patterns, quality verification, or repeatable business workflows.
solution: Structured an interactive curriculum covering prompt architecture, research synthesis, document drafting, and responsible human-in-the-loop review.
